name: OpenMD_policy_settings_20261028
description: OpenMD HD1910 policy settings + model index. Every path in this file resolves relative to the folder that contains it (policies/). ONNX files are the deployable exports; .pt files (where present) are the full rsl_rl training checkpoints they came from.

walk.weights_verified: bit-exact (actor MLP tensors of the .pt appear unchanged in the .onnx)

stand.weights_verified: bit-exact (actor MLP tensors of the .pt appear unchanged in the .onnx)

ground_pick.weights_verified: no local checkpoint: patched export (ankle gain 0.37 baked into the graph), so no .pt on this machine is bit-identical. ONNX only, by decision.

kick_right.weights_verified: no local checkpoint: source run 2026-10-08_16-10-25_openmd-ball-kick-right is not on this machine. ONNX only, by decision.

roulade.weights_verified: no local checkpoint: source run 2026-10-08_02-14-04_openmd-m6-roulade is not on this machine. ONNX only, by decision.

notes: Paths in this file are relative to the JSON's own folder (policies/). Original board-side paths are kept per model under models.*.board_path for reference only.

sitstand is intentionally NOT shipped here (behaviour was not good enough). policy.sitstand = "none" and models.sitstand = null; the untouched original stays at C:\Users\59892\Desktop\稳定版\models\sitstand.onnx (sha256 7356e318a7ee...). Put it back by copying that file in as OpenMD_sitstand.onnx and setting policy.sitstand to that name.
action_scale=0.7 is the walk/default net scale; standing_action_scale=1.0 is the stand net scale. robotd 0.13.3 has no walk_action_scale key.
stand=OpenMD_stand.onnx (model_17500) and stand_on_zero_command=true: zero twist selects stand; nonzero twist selects walk m9999.
kick_left=none; kick_right/roulade are stable-aux; roulade_duration=1.0 s.
limp_fall=false: no automatic fall recovery; a pad disconnect does not disable the policy.
head/legs lowpass unset -> 0.5/0.7; gain unset -> 6; voltage_adapt unset -> false; standing_gain_ratio=1.0.
HOME: neck_pitch/head_pitch 20 deg, hip_roll -5/+5, hip_pitch -26.2/+26.2, ankle +26/-26, knee 0. The list carries 15 entries because the board config also covers the mouth joint.

walk/stand ship a .pt each, proven bit-exact against its ONNX by hashing the actor MLP initializers. ground_pick/kick_right/roulade are ONNX-only: no checkpoint for those three exists on this machine (ground_pick is additionally a patched graph).
Every ONNX is [1,61] obs -> [1,14] actions with the observation normalizer baked in; do not re-export by hand from a .pt.
